Handle(KeyEvent, int)

Closed: Enter, Space or Down opens. Open: Up/Down (or k/j) move, Enter commits, Esc cancels. Returns false for keys it does not use (e.g. Tab while closed), so the caller can handle them.

HandleMouse(MouseEvent, int)

Closed: a click on the field opens. Open: a click on an item commits it, the wheel scrolls the list, a click on the field or anywhere else cancels. Returns whether the event was used; a click elsewhere closes the list but returns false, so the caller can still act on it (e.g. focus what was clicked).
